description: Op-Ed by Nicole Malliotakis We’re all familiar with the phrase “follow the money” which was popularized by "All the President’s Men," the 1976 film on the Watergate break-in and the subsequent downfall of President Nixon. Now, more than four decades later, the phrase still holds true, though this time it applies to Members of Congress
